items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Yeah, Albert Cal, Wade Martin, yeah. The great fella they had there.

ctx.x: I remember the 25. Yeah. Did you ever have bands in the 25 then? I thought it was mostly a gambling place. There was a gambling in the back, they had bands there too.

Did they have any dancing or what they played for? They had some good fellows there, like this fella, Albert Cal, I don't know much about him. Oh, piano players. Yeah, Albert Cal, Wade Martin, yeah. The great fella they had there. Used to come in with such a big town, you know.
Yeah. I was reading a little book here about the district.
